concerns.text: The specification treats elemental weight fractions as independent predictor variables, but by definition they sum to 1 (100 %). This linear dependency violates the assumption of feature independence underlying many statistical analyses (e.g., permutation importance significance testing, partial dependence plots, and regression coefficient interpretation). The spec does not address how this constraint will be handled (e.g., dropping one element, using compositional data analysis, or applying appropriate transformations). As a result, the validation of model performance and feature importance may be circular or misleading, constituting a scientific flaw.
